apps.name: Aura Health
apps.subtitle: Private health dashboard
apps.localizedDescription: Your vitals, labs, medications, habits and health notes in one private dashboard. Aura uses SwiftData, supports Apple Health on iOS, optional CloudKit sync and an optional Claude-powered health assistant using your own API key. This IPA is an unofficial automated build of the upstream open-source project.
